preamble.summary: 2 Samuel 1 narrates the Amalekite messenger's report of Saul's death and David's lament 'How the mighty have fallen.' 4QSamᵃ preserves portions with minor variants.
preamble.notable_variants: Minor wording variants only. The lament's poetic structure tracks MT.

variant_notes: 'How the mighty have fallen' — the threefold refrain (vv. 19, 25, 27) tracks MT and structures David's lament for Saul and Jonathan.
